svg.title: OnHolidai trip-planning agent
svg.desc: The agent uses Nebius Token Factory with NVIDIA Nemotron models, Google Maps Grounding Lite MCP, Tavily search, and an application-owned supplier gateway connecting Duffel flights, Nuitee accommodation, and Viator activities. Trips have saved versions and a separate booking review.
